scope: Bounded primary Catholic source follow-up for old-style Julian Byzantine reading appointments in civil 2026 and 2027. No native data, lectionary, or calendar import was changed.
recommendation: Keep ugcc-julian feast-only. Current Catholic parish evidence now independently verifies the old fixed calendar and Eastern Pascha, but none of the inspected sources supplies its daily Scripture appointments. Do not offset new-style readings or silently import an Orthodox table.

sources.publisher: Our Lady of Fatima Russian Byzantine Catholic Church, a parish of the Archdiocese of San Francisco
sources.verification: Actual primary parish HTML and one successful read of its public Google calendar feed. No historical parish reputation or search excerpt used to establish current dates.
sources.observanceLabelKind: The observance values below are short editorial labels for the inspected ICS SUMMARY strings, not verbatim event titles.

observedAllDayEvents.observance: Meeting of the Lord in the Temple

bounds: Nativity and Theophany independently establish old-style fixed feasts; Pascha is separately observed on 12 April 2026.
Event counts are explicit DTSTART records, including services, recurring masters and overrides; they are not counts of unique feast days or an expanded annual calendar.
The feed has no explicit 2027 records. Recurring service times do not establish 2027 feast or reading appointments.
The 2026 events contain no DESCRIPTION text or Scripture citations. A Passion Gospels service title does not identify its reading boundaries.
Russian Catholic parish practice does not by itself establish every UGCC parish's saints, precedence or transfer rubrics.
The parish's January and other dated records are useful primary date evidence, not a complete annual lectionary or an automatic native import.
sources.rights: Parish HTML footer: copyright 2016 Our Lady of Fatima, all rights reserved. No bulk reuse license or public reading API documented on the inspected page. Preserve the source link and request a reusable dated appointment table before importing publisher text.
